all_of.source_quote: students are required to complete the two required courses
all_of.description: BAEP 452 and BUAD 301, with BUAD 301 required before BAEP 452.

all_of.source_quote: enough elective courses to achieve a total of 16 units
all_of.description: Elective courses totaling enough units so that, combined with the 7 required-course units, the minor reaches 16 total units.
all_of.note: The catalogue states Business majors must complete 23 total units (not just 16) to complete the minor, likely because required courses overlap with their major; this per-major variation cannot be checked from a course list and is listed in unclassified.

unclassified.source_quote: To enroll, students must have completed a minimum of 32 units
unclassified.why: Admission prerequisite (unit count and GPA) for enrolling in the minor, not a degree requirement.

unclassified.source_quote: Business majors thus require 23 total units and other majors 16 total units
unclassified.why: A unit total that varies by the student's declared major cannot be expressed as a single checkable threshold.
